title: Service weather: now (last 15 minutes), the last 7 days and the next 7 days  ·  same colour rules as the five tiles below
description: Reads AppRequests and AppAvailabilityResults of minibank-api: the same calls and the same colour rules as the five tiles below (availability and success green from 99.9 %, technical failures green below 1 %, P95 green below 800 ms and red from 1,000 ms). NOW = the last 15 minutes, live, nothing left out: it turns stormy while a fault runs and clears when it ends; business declines (409) are answers, not failures, and never make it rain. LAST 7 DAYS = one tile per day (WIB) with the lab drill minutes left out; days before 13 Nov 2026 were lab build days and are not counted. ERROR BUDGET = the last 7 days (from 13 Nov 2026 14:00 WIB at the earliest), drills left out, against the SLA of this board: 99.9 % of the calls without a technical failure, and 95 % of the calls under 1 second (P95 below 1,000 ms). NEXT 7 DAYS and the heat advisory = the payments speed trend and the dated risks of the Look-ahead risk register (MiniBankLookahead), so the dates match the Look-ahead board. Pinned to now: the time picker does not change this panel. Added 18 Nov 2026 (approved by the lab owner).
